description: This is a Java source file defining the LogFragment class, a fragment for displaying logs within an Android application. It creates a view hierarchy containing a ScrollView and a custom LogView, manages layout and appearance, and handles text change events to scroll to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that contains a LogView for displaying log data, managing view creation, layout, and automatic scrolling.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and initializes the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, appearance, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Handles fragment view creation, adds a TextWatcher to scroll to the bottom upon text changes.
